$schema_note: Source of truth for which Edge Functions are allowed to be deployed to the shared Supabase project (urjsnguzzzwcnaxwghbo). Deploy tooling (CI, scripts) must read ONLY this file to decide what to deploy — never enumerate supabase/functions/ directly. A directory existing is not permission to deploy it. `status` describes what the function IS (active/legacy); `deploy_allowed` describes whether it's currently SAFE/AUTHORIZED to deploy — the two are independent, see docs/ops/DEPLOY_GOVERNANCE.md. Principle for check-functions-drift.mjs: any live function not explicitly accounted for in one of the buckets below is treated as DRIFT (fails), not silently excused — 'unknown until proven otherwise', not the reverse.

stripe-webhooks.blocking_reason: Required secret STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is absent from project secrets — cannot verify any Stripe signature, every invocation 400s. 'active' here means 'this is the intended canonical handler', NOT 'this is operationally ready' — do not let CI treat active as a green light. Unblock: confirm Stripe Dashboard endpoint config, set the secret, redeploy from git HEAD (also picks up the missing processed_stripe_events idempotency code — see STRIPE-WEBHOOK-CUTOVER.md).
